answer_1.quote: We explore several forms in generating the explicitation: 1) SHORT: inserting one or two words ... 2) MID: several words or a phrase integrated ... 3) LONG: 1-3 sentences ...
answer_1.outputs: generated explicitations (short, mid, long) inserted into the translation

answer_2.quote: We adopt the same metrics, Expected Wins (EW) and EW with an oracle buzzer (EWO) as Rodriguez et al. (2019) and Han et al. (2022).

answer_4.quote: We ask the same human annotators who identified naturally occurring explicitations (Section 3.4) if our automatic explicitation is as useful as natural ones.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate decision, generation quality, and integration on a three‑step Likert scale (high, mid, low).
